display.attractionName: Under the Sea: Journey of The Little Mermaid

description: A Mickey in his 1928 steamboat-era look is worked into the rockwork of the outdoor queue. It is a full figure rather than three circles, small and the same color as the rock, and almost nobody stumbles onto it by accident.

whereToLook.scene: Outdoor rockwork of the standby queue
whereToLook.exactSpot: Carved into the rock faces along the queue. Look for the silhouette of the early cartoon Mickey rather than a three-circle shape.

bestTip: Scan the rock at and just above eye level as you move, and look for a figure rather than circles.

viewing.notes: The exact section of the queue is not pinned down. If you find it, note where and send it in.
